data.title: Cloud Phone Behavioral Anomaly — Device-Environment Decorrelation Detection
data.description: Detects cloud phone behavioral anomalies indicative of industrial-scale dropper/mule account creation. Cloud phones — remote-access Android devices running genuine firmware on ARM hardware in data centers — pass hardware attestation and present authentic device signals, making them invisible to traditional emulator detection. This rule uses a composite scoring approach combining device-environment decorrelation signals: perpetual full battery, absence of accelerometer motion during active sessions, presence of VPN/proxy and vendor management apps, unusually high banking app density, and recent device first-seen dates. Group-IB reports cloud phone rental from $0.10/hour with pre-verified dropper accounts selling for $50–200 on darknet markets. UK APP fraud losses reached £485.2M in 2023 with dropper accounts as the top contributing factor.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_battery AND filter_motion during active session AND (filter_vpn OR filter_vendor_app) AND filter_banking_density AND filter_new_device
detection.composite_score: Assign weighted score: battery_level=100 (+20), accelerometer_motion_events=0 during active session (+25), vpn_proxy_app_installed (+15), banking_app_count >= 3 (+15), vendor_management_app_present (+20), device_first_seen < 30 days (+5). Alert threshold: score >= 60.

enrichment_required.source: Days since device first appeared in telemetry
Comparison of IP geolocation timezone vs device-reported timezone

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Cloud Phone Behavioral Anomaly Detection
// Detects device-environment decorrelation signals indicative of cloud phone infrastructure
device_platform="android"
battery_level=100
accelerometer_motion_events=0
(vpn_proxy_app_installed="true" OR vendor_management_app_present IN ["LDC Store", "LD Assistant"])
banking_app_count>=3
| device_first_seen_days := dateDiff(now(), device_first_seen_date, unit=days)
| cloud_phone_risk_score := (
    if(battery_level=100, 20, 0)
    + if(accelerometer_motion_events=0, 25, 0)
    + if(vpn_proxy_app_installed="true", 15, 0)
    + if(banking_app_count>=3, 15, 0)
    + if(vendor_management_app_present=*, 20, 0)
    + if(device_first_seen_days<30, 5, 0)
  )
| cloud_phone_risk_score >= 60
| groupBy(device_id, function=[
    collect([battery_level, accelerometer_motion_events, banking_app_count,
             vpn_proxy_app_installed, vendor_management_app_present,
             device_first_seen_date, ip_address, ip_geolocation,
             device_timezone, cloud_phone_risk_score])
  ])
| sort(cloud_phone_risk_score, order=desc)

queries.sql:
-- SQL for Cloud Phone Behavioral Anomaly Detection
-- Detects device-environment decorrelation signals from cloud phone infrastructure
SELECT
  d.device_id,
  d.battery_level,
  d.accelerometer_motion_events,
  d.banking_app_count,
  d.vpn_proxy_app_installed,
  d.vendor_management_app_present,
  d.device_first_seen_date,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, d.device_first_seen_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS device_first_seen_days,
  d.ip_address,
  d.ip_geolocation,
  d.device_timezone,
  (CASE WHEN d.battery_level = 100 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN d.accelerometer_motion_events = 0 THEN 25 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN d.vpn_proxy_app_installed = TRUE THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN d.banking_app_count >= 3 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN d.vendor_management_app_present IS NOT NULL THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, d.device_first_seen_date, CURRENT_DATE) < 30 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS cloud_phone_risk_score
FROM mobile_device_telemetry d
WHERE d.device_platform = 'android'
  AND d.battery_level = 100
  AND d.accelerometer_motion_events = 0
  AND (d.vpn_proxy_app_installed = TRUE
       OR d.vendor_management_app_present IN ('LDC Store', 'LD Assistant'))
  AND d.banking_app_count >= 3
  AND DATEDIFF(DAY, d.device_first_seen_date, CURRENT_DATE) < 30
HAVING cloud_phone_risk_score >= 60
ORDER BY cloud_phone_risk_score DESC
